doctor_tenma.name: Doctor Tenma
doctor_tenma.description: A brilliant neurosurgeon driven by an unwavering sense of justice and compassion. Despite being caught in a web of tragedy and moral dilemmas, he remains determined to save lives and uphold his humanity at any cost.
doctor_tenma.active_ability: Emergency Surgery - Choose 2 players tonight. If one survives and the other dies, both survive. You cannot pick the same 2 people again next night.
doctor_tenma.footer: Tomorrow will be a good day.

ayanokoji_kiyotaka.name: Ayanokoji Kiyotaka
ayanokoji_kiyotaka.description: A mysterious mastermind who rarely reveals his true abilities. With unmatched intelligence and calculated decisions, he quietly manipulates every situation to achieve his goals.
ayanokoji_kiyotaka.active_ability: Observation - Observe a player. Learn who they visited and who visited them / Public Reveal - Starting from Night 4, publicly reveal the role of your target (4 day cooldown).
ayanokoji_kiyotaka.passive_ability: Unreadable - Immune to Framing, Forging, Mimicry, and any deceptions that alter role/faction appearance; investigations are always 100% accurate.

l.name: L
l.description: The world's greatest detective, renowned for his extraordinary intellect and unmatched deductive skills. Behind his eccentric demeanor lies a relentless investigator determined to uncover the truth, no matter the cost.
l.active_ability: Deduction - Investigate target's alignment, this tells you their faction / Cross Examination - Compare two players' factions, this tells you if they are on the same or different side. Twice per game.
l.passive_ability: 99% Certain - Scanning the same target on two different nights uncovers their exact role.
l.footer: There is no heaven or hell. I will solve this case.

tobirama_senju.name: Tobirama Senju
tobirama_senju.description: The Second Hokage, celebrated for his brilliance, discipline, and tactical genius. A master of powerful jutsu and battlefield strategy, he always places the safety of the village above all else.
tobirama_senju.active_ability: Sensory Technique - Learn everyone who visited target player tonight / Flying Thunder Counter - Protect a player tonight, completely nullifying any attacks and learning who the attackers were. If the target dies, the attacker is still revealed (Twice per game).
tobirama_senju.passive_ability: Master Sensor - Learn which players visited Tobirama every night.

hiromi_higuruma.name: Hiromi Higuruma
hiromi_higuruma.description: A former defense attorney who wields justice as both a weapon and a burden. Guided by an unshakable moral compass, he exposes wrongdoing and forces others to face the consequences of their actions.
hiromi_higuruma.active_ability: Deadly Sentencing - Instantly execute a player during Nomination phase, twice per game / Retrial - Acquit defendant during trial, twice per game.
hiromi_higuruma.action_prompt: Select a day or trial action to perform:
hiromi_higuruma.footer: The law exists to protect people.

levi_ackerman.name: Levi Ackerman
levi_ackerman.description: Humanity's strongest soldier, feared for his unmatched combat skills and unwavering resolve. Calm under pressure and fiercely loyal to his comrades, Levi never hesitates to make the difficult choices for the greater good.
levi_ackerman.active_ability: ODM Execution - Attack a player, 3 uses / Precision Strike - ODM Execution ignores protection tonight, 1 use.
levi_ackerman.passive_ability: Survivor's Guilt - Become exhausted for 1 cycle if you kill a Protagonist player.
levi_ackerman.footer: Give up on your dreams and die.

maomao.name: Maomao
maomao.description: A sharp-witted apothecary with an insatiable curiosity for medicine, poisons, and mysteries. Her keen observational skills and logical mind allow her to uncover truths that others fail to notice.
maomao.active_ability:
Postmortem Analysis - Select a dead player. You will receive 3 names, one of whom is the killer (2 day cooldown). / 
Brew Potion - Brew a potion of your choice, each potion has a 2 day cooldown:
• Potion of Truth - Reveals the target's faction.
• Potion of Invisibility - Target goes invisible.
• Potion of Happiness - Distract (roleblock) the target.
• Potion of Revitalization - Restores target's cooldowns.
• Potion of Intelligence - Target gains +1 vote for tomorrow.
maomao.passive_ability: Photographic Memory - If the corpse is fresh (killed last night), the Postmortem Analysis has a 40% chance to guarantee another protagonist name is included among the suspects.
maomao.footer: Curiosity killed the cat... but I'm still curious.

frieren.name: Frieren
frieren.description: An ancient elven mage whose quiet demeanor conceals centuries of wisdom and extraordinary magical power. Though she struggles to understand human emotions, her journey teaches her the true value of the bonds forged over a lifetime.
frieren.active_ability: Ancient Binding - Bind 2 players together, if one dies, the survivor is hidden for a night / Demon Detection - Choose 3 players, you will learn how many of those belong to the antagonists / Zoltraak Specialist - Disable the passives of all antagonists and neutrals tonight this has a 2 day cooldown.
frieren.footer: The journey itself is what gives memories their meaning.

blackbeard.name: Blackbeard
blackbeard.description: A ruthless pirate driven by boundless ambition and an insatiable desire for power. Cunning, unpredictable, and willing to betray anyone, Blackbeard believes destiny favors those bold enough to seize it.
blackbeard.active_ability: Darkness Logia - Roleblock a player, the player with the Roleblock status effect cannot use their ability that day / Tremor Fruit - Once per game, roleblock every single neutral and protagonist player for that night.
blackbeard.footer: A man's dream... will never die!

light_yagami.name: Light Yagami
light_yagami.description: A brilliant student whose unwavering belief in his own sense of justice drives him to reshape the world. Armed with exceptional intellect and relentless determination, he orchestrates every move with chilling precision.
light_yagami.active_ability: Death Note - Choose a player and guess their role, if correct, they die that night. / The Devil's Pen - Write a player's name in the Death Note, they die unpreventably after 3 nights, 3 night cooldown.
light_yagami.action_prompt: Select a player to target in your Death Note:
light_yagami.footer: I'll become the god of the new world.

muzan_kibutsuji.name: Muzan Kibutsuji
muzan_kibutsuji.description: The first and most powerful demon, feared for his overwhelming strength and ruthless pursuit of perfection. Cold, manipulative, and merciless, Muzan commands absolute loyalty while eliminating anyone who threatens his reign.
muzan_kibutsuji.active_ability: Blood Demon Art - Every 3rd night, starting Night 3, transform a Protagonist player with 85% chance to become a demon with no powers, 10% chance to become a Lower Moon Demon with the ability to Roleblock, and a 5% chance to become an Upper Moon Demon with the ability to kill.
muzan_kibutsuji.passive_ability: Instant Regeneration - Always survive the first attack, healing Muzan Kibutsuji gives him an extra passive charge.

makima.name: Makima
makima.description: A mysterious Public Safety officer who exudes calm authority and unmatched composure. Beneath her gentle demeanor lies a master manipulator capable of bending both allies and enemies to her will.
makima.active_ability: Control - Choose a player, redirect target's night action to any other player of choosing. / Bang - Deals unstoppable attack once per game after contract is activated and 2 unique redirects succeed.
makima.passive_ability: Prime Minister's Contract - Once per game, survive execution, Day immediately ends, role is not revealed.
makima.action_prompt: Select the player you wish to control:

hisoka.name: Hisoka Morow
hisoka.win_condition: Survive until the end of the game, and successfully use all of your abilities (Bungee Gum, Texture Surprise, Bloodlust) at least once during the game.
hisoka.description: Hisoka has no interest in justice or domination. He lives for excitement, manipulating others and turning the game into his own personal playground.
hisoka.active_ability: Bungee Gum - Link two players. If either wins while both are alive, they both win / Texture Surprise - Twice per game, disguise a players faction alignment / Bloodlust - Once per game, redirect any ability targeted at Hisoka back to the attacker.
hisoka.action_prompt: Select the first player to link with Bungee Gum:
hisoka.footer: The pleasure comes not from victory, but from the fight itself.

gilgamesh.name: Gilgamesh
gilgamesh.win_condition: Find all of your swords to become the Horseman of Apocalypse, then survive for 1 day to trigger The Gate's of Babylon.
gilgamesh.description: The King of Heroes, Gilgamesh is a proud and unrivaled monarch who views the world as his rightful domain. Possessing immeasurable power and unwavering confidence, he crushes those he deems unworthy without hesitation.
gilgamesh.active_ability: Gate of Babylon - Visit a player to search for your sword. If found, you retrieve it. The number of swords needed to be collected depends on the lobby size, 3 for small ones, 5 for larger ones.
gilgamesh.passive_ability: The Gates of Babylon - Transform once all swords are collected, if Gilgamesh is not lynched that day, wipe the entire mafia and protagonist faction and win the game.
gilgamesh.action_prompt: Select a player to search for your sword:

eren_jaeger.name: Eren Jaeger
eren_jaeger.win_condition: Survive until Night 5 to trigger The Rumbling, then kill everyone until you are the last one standing.
eren_jaeger.description: A determined soldier whose unyielding desire for freedom drives him to challenge the fate of the world itself. Fiercely passionate and willing to sacrifice everything for his convictions, Eren's choices forever reshape history.
eren_jaeger.active_ability: Founding Vision - Select a player every night and learn their faction / The Rumbling - From Night 5 onwards, Eren transforms and gains the ability to kill a player every day. Eren cannot be lynched after the Rumbling begins.
eren_jaeger.action_prompt: Select a player to look at or attack:
eren_jaeger.footer: If someone tries to take my freedom, I won't hesitate to take theirs.

mahoraga.name: Eight-Handled Sword Divergent Sila Divine General Mahoraga
mahoraga.win_condition: Be the last remaining player alive in the lobby.
mahoraga.description: The ultimate shikigami of the Ten Shadows Technique. Summoned once and never defeated, Mahoraga's Eight-Handled Wheel continuously turns — adapting to every ability, every faction, every force thrown at it. It does not fight. It evolves. And once it has adapted to everything, nothing in this world can stop it.
mahoraga.active_ability: Adaptation — Every night, visit a player to attempt adapting to their faction. 1st faction: 75% success. 2nd faction: 50%. 3rd faction: 25%. Once adapted to a faction, their night-kill abilities can no longer harm you.
mahoraga.passive_ability: Absolute Adaptation — After successfully adapting to all 3 factions (Protagonist, Antagonist, Neutral), you become immune to being voted out. Only unstoppable one-hit abilities (e.g. Light's Devil's Pen, Frieza's Golden Form, Bang, Gates of Babylon) can eliminate you.

villager.name: Default Villager
villager.win_condition: Help the protagonists win. (Wins with Protagonists)
villager.description: A normal citizen of the anime world.

frieza.name: Frieza
frieza.description: The ruthless emperor of the universe, Frieza rules through fear, overwhelming power, and absolute cruelty. Arrogant yet calculating, he views all life as beneath him and will stop at nothing to dominate those who oppose him.
frieza.active_ability: Death Beam - Choose a player to eliminate every night.
frieza.passive_ability: Golden Frieza - Ignores protection, immune to blocks/redirections after 3 kills.
frieza.action_prompt: Select a player to target with Death Beam:

demon.name: Demon
demon.description: A human turned demon by Muzan Kibutsuji.

lower_moon.name: Lower Moon Demon
lower_moon.description: A powerful demon who serves Muzan Kibutsuji.

upper_moon.name: Upper Moon Demon
upper_moon.description: A lethal demon with supreme power.

kishibe.name: Kishibe
kishibe.description: A grizzled, battle worn hunter who survived countless encounters with devils. Kishibe has no illusions about humanity, he fights because he has nothing left to lose. Taciturn and ruthless, he is considered one of the strongest humans alive.
kishibe.active_ability: Veteran's Instinct (Alert) - Go on Alert, anyone who visits you is attacked with a Powerful Attack, 3 charges / Broken Screw - Once per game, Choose a player, if they visit you tonight, your Alert charge is saved.
kishibe.passive_ability: Battle-Hardened - The first time someone attempts to roleblock, control, or redirect Kishibe, the effect fails and the visitor is notified that their target resisted them.
kishibe.footer: I became a devil hunter so I could kill them. That is all.

tosen.name: Kaname Tosen
tosen.description: The Blind Judge who seeks a path of least bloodshed. Tosen wields the most terrifying Bankai - Suzumushi Tsuishiki: Enma Korogi - which erases all senses of those trapped within it. His absolute judgment cannot be defied.
tosen.active_ability: Bankai: Enma Korogi - Every night, detain a player inside your Bankai. They cannot act, cannot be targeted, and may only communicate privately with Tosen. On the following night, choose to release them or execute them (max 3 executions). Executing a protagonist permanently removes your execution ability.
tosen.passive_ability: Suzumushi - Players detained inside Enma Korogi cannot activate any abilities that trigger upon death, while dying, or after death. Roles that passively evade death will not be activated. His judgment is absolute.
tosen.footer: Justice without power is mere sentiment. Power without justice is tyranny.

dazai.name: Osamu Dazai
dazai.description: A member of the Armed Detective Agency, Dazai possesses the ability to nullify any supernatural power with a single touch. Beneath his eccentric, suicidal exterior lies a mind of unmatched strategic genius.
dazai.active_ability: No Longer Human - Select a player every night, nullify the target's abilities for the night, they cannot use active abilities, their passive is suppressed, and visits are cancelled. The cooldown is 1 night.
dazai.passive_ability: Unpredictable - Dazai is immune to redirects, control, or forced visits. His chosen action will always proceed.
dazai.footer: There is no such thing as an ideal in this world.

asta.name: Asta
asta.description: An orphan who received a five-leaf clover grimoire and wields Anti-Magic swords. Despite having zero mana, his sheer physical strength, determination, and anti-magic make him one of the most formidable magic knights.
asta.active_ability: Demon Destroyer Sword - Select a player every night to cleanse all negative status effects from them. / Black Divider - Choose a player every other night and nullify their abilities for that day. / Devil Union - Once per game, Asta can merge with his devil and nullify EVERY hostile ability to protect the town
asta.passive_ability: Anti-Magic - Immune to all negative non-physical abilities (Roleblocks, frames, hexes, silences, curses, redirects). Not immune to direct kills or lynching.
asta.footer: My magic is never giving up!

lelouch.name: Lelouch Lamperouge
lelouch.description: An exiled prince of the Holy Britannian Empire who gains the power of Geass, the power of absolute obedience. Donning the mask of Zero, he leads the Black Knights to tear down the world's corruption and construct a gentler tomorrow.
lelouch.active_ability:
Geass - Choose a player. The following day all votes towards that player count double in both nomination and voting phases, 1 Night cooldown. / 
Black Knight - Once per game, cause a rebellion in the lobby during discussion, ending the day phase immediately to start voting.
lelouch.passive_ability: Zero Requiem - If Lelouch is executed/lynched at any point during the day, the game ends immediately and Lelouch wins the match.
lelouch.win_condition: If all the protagonists are dead.
lelouch.footer: The only ones who should kill are those prepared to be killed.
